{{Otheruses|Grub}}
A '''grub-hatchery''' was a location on the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] where infant Neimoidian grubs were raised. Similar but smaller than [[Neimoidian communal hive]]s they were the original place where Neimoidians put their young. But the communal hives were larger and cheaper to use so only wealthy Neimoidians used the grub-hatcheries.<ref name="Words of Episode I">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> During the [[Battle on Neimoidia/Legends|Battle of Neimoidia]], in the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the grub-hatcheries were destroyed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

The walls of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] office on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] were modeled after those of a grub-hatchery.<ref name="Words of Episode I" />
